elements.requirement: A local housing authority may, in accordance with a scheme it has made (and, if the authority is in Wales, approved by the Secretary of State), make grants to or for the benefit of its qualifying tenants or licensees to assist each recipient to obtain accommodation otherwise than as a tenant or licensee of the authority by acquiring an interest in a dwelling-house, by carrying out works to a dwelling-house to provide additional accommodation, or by both means.
elements.quote: the authority may make grants to or for the benefit of qualifying tenants or licensees of the authority with a view to assisting each person to whom or for whose benefit a grant is made to obtain accommodation otherwise than as a tenant or licensee of the authority

elements.requirement: A scheme made by a local housing authority must contain such provisions as the authority considers appropriate, together with any provisions required by the Secretary of State as a condition of approval where the authority is in Wales.
elements.quote: A scheme under this section shall contain such provisions as the local housing authority considers appropriate together with , where the authority is in Wales, any which the Secretary of State may require as a condition of his approval

elements.requirement: A local housing authority's scheme may include provisions specifying, or providing for the determination of, the qualifying tenants or licensees, the interests to be acquired, the eligible works, the circumstances for making grants, the grant amounts and terms, limits on the total number and amount of grants, and the scheme's operative period.
elements.quote: a scheme may include provisions specifying, or providing for the determination of— (a) the persons who are qualifying tenants or licensees for the purposes of the scheme; (b) the interests which qualifying tenants or licensees may be assisted to acquire; (c) the works for the carrying out of which grants may be made; (d) the circumstances in which a grant may be made for the benefit of a qualifying tenant or licensee; (e) the amount of the grant which may be made in any particular case and the terms on which it may be made; (f) the limits on the total number and amount of grants which may be made; and (g) the period within which the scheme is to apply.

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may approve a scheme made by a local housing authority in Wales either with conditions or without conditions.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State may approve a scheme made by a local housing authority in Wales under this section with or without conditions

elements.requirement: Once a scheme has been made (and approved, where the authority is in Wales), the local housing authority must take such steps as it considers appropriate to bring the scheme to the attention of persons likely to be able to benefit from it, as well as any other steps directed by the Secretary of State in a particular case to secure publicity.
elements.quote: a local housing authority shall take such steps as it considers appropriate to bring the scheme to the attention of persons likely to be able to benefit from it and shall take such other steps (if any) as the Secretary of State may direct in any particular case to secure publicity for the scheme.

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may revoke approval of a scheme by giving notice to the local housing authority concerned, but such revocation does not affect the operation of the scheme regarding grants made or agreed before the date of the notice.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State may revoke an approval of a scheme under this section by a notice given to the local housing authority concerned; and, where such a notice is given, the revocation shall not affect the operation of the scheme in relation to any grants made or agreed before the date of the notice.

elements.requirement: A person dealing with a local housing authority that has made (and, in Wales, had approved) a scheme is not concerned to see or enquire whether the terms of the scheme have been or are being complied with.
elements.quote: a person dealing with the authority shall not be concerned to see or enquire whether the terms of the scheme have been or are being complied with

elements.requirement: A failure to comply with the terms of a scheme does not invalidate any grant purporting to be made in accordance with the scheme unless the grant recipient has actual notice of that failure.
elements.quote: any failure to comply with the terms of a scheme shall not invalidate any grant purporting to be made in accordance with the scheme unless the person to whom the grant is made has actual notice of the failure.

elements.requirement: The term 'local housing authority' carries the meaning assigned by section 1 of the Housing Act 1985.
elements.quote: “local housing authority” has the meaning assigned by section 1 of the Housing Act 1985

elements.requirement: The term 'dwelling-house' carries the meaning assigned by section 112 of the Housing Act 1985.
elements.quote: “dwelling-house” has the meaning assigned by section 112 of that Act

elements.requirement: The term 'tenant' excludes a tenant holding under a long tenancy as defined in section 115 of the Housing Act 1985.
elements.quote: “tenant” does not include a tenant under a long tenancy, as defined in section 115 of that Act.
